github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Write a single concise commit subject line in imperative mood, max 72 characters. Always start with a Conventional Commits type prefix followed by a colon and a space. Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, chore, test, build, ci, revert. Add a scope in parentheses identifying the affected area of this client-side React/TypeScript app, for example a feature component directory (home, workspace, mock-exams, notes, question-banks, settings, header), a cross-cutting area (context, i18n, services, types, data), the build/tooling (vite, tailwind, deploy), docs, or config (kiro). When a change spans more than one area, join the scopes with a plus sign, e.g. fix(notes+services):. Do not add a body, bullet points, or explanatory paragraphs. Do not add a Co-Authored-By footer or any trailer. Summarize only the essence of the change. Only add a short body if the change is genuinely complex and cannot be conveyed in the subject alone.
